'''Na-TaK''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] from the [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] active during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3639 BBY]] Gree forces on [[Asation]] were attacked by the creatures coming through the [[Grand Hypergate]] that was opened by [[Kephess]], servant of the [[Dread Masters]]. [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] Gatemaster [[Beltek'k]] went to ask for help from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and was successful as forces under [[Major]] [[Cobus]] were sent to Asation. However, they were not sufficient and Na-TaK contacted Republic Minister [[Sosa]], urging her to send more capable individuals to combat Kephess and close the hypergate.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Na-TaK appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during a holocall with Minister Sosa, the Operation courier for the "Terror From Beyond" operation.
